title: Java Developer
description: Master enterprise software engineering, resilient microservices, distributed transaction processing, and scalable architectures using Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.

goal.objective: Design and deploy robust, high-throughput enterprise systems, distributed microservices, and banking-grade backends using Java and the Spring ecosystem.

learn.summary: Master modern Java 21 (Virtual Threads, Records, Pattern Matching), Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Kafka message streaming, and Docker orchestration.
key_competencies: Spring Boot 3 REST APIs & Dependency Injection
Spring Data JPA & Hibernate ORM Tuning

capstone_projects.title: High-Concurrency Banking Transaction Engine with Spring Boot 3 & Virtual Threads
capstone_projects.description: Engineer an ACID-compliant double-entry ledger processing 15,000 transactions/sec utilizing Java 21 Virtual Threads, optimistic locking, and Kafka event streams.

capstone_projects.title: Event-Driven Distributed Order Fulfillment System with Resilience4j
capstone_projects.description: Construct a distributed microservices platform implementing Saga orchestration, distributed tracing, circuit breakers, and transactional outbox patterns.

certifications: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17/21 Developer
interview_focus: Java Virtual Machine (JVM) Memory Model (Heap, Metaspace, GC Algorithms ZGC & G1)
Java 21 Features (Virtual Threads, Pattern Matching, Records, Sealed Classes)
Spring Bean Lifecycle, Dependency Injection & @Transactional Propagation Levels
Distributed Transactions (Saga Pattern, Two-Phase Commit, Transactional Outbox Pattern)

tree.name: Core Java Foundations
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable modern Java foundation (Java 17 & Java 21 LTS): master the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) architecture, strongly-typed object modeling, memory layout, functional pipelines, and high-throughput virtual threads (Project Loom).

children.name: Java Syntax & OOP Principles
children.description: Master modern Java language features: records for immutable data carriers, sealed classes and interfaces for restricted hierarchies, pattern matching for `switch` and `instanceof`, text blocks, access modifiers, method overriding vs overloading, and object-oriented principles prioritizing composition over deep inheritance trees.

children.name: Java Collections Framework & Generics
children.description: Master the Java Collections Framework and Generics internals: dynamic resizing in `ArrayList`, `HashMap` bucket hashing and red-black tree conversion (treeification threshold of 8), lock striping in `ConcurrentHashMap`, ordered traversal with `LinkedHashMap` and `TreeMap`, and Generics type erasure, wildcards (`? extends T` covariance, `? super T` contravariance - PECS rule), and bounded type parameters.

children.name: Exception Handling, File I/O & Networking
children.description: Master robust error handling and I/O architectures: checked vs unchecked runtime exceptions, try-with-resources with `AutoCloseable`, custom domain exception hierarchies, and Java NIO.2 non-blocking I/O (`Path`, `Files`, `ByteBuffer`, `FileChannel`, `AsynchronousSocketChannel`, and selector event demultiplexing).

children.name: Advanced Java: Lambdas & Stream API
children.description: Master functional programming in Java: lambda expressions, functional interfaces (`Function`, `Predicate`, `Supplier`, `Consumer`), Stream API mechanics (spliterators, lazy pipeline evaluation, terminal collectors with `Collectors.groupingBy` and `teeing`), avoiding parallel stream thread pool starvation, and idiomatic `Optional<T>` usage to eliminate `NullPointerException`.

children.name: Java Concurrency & Multithreading
children.description: Master modern Java concurrency and Project Loom: virtual threads (`Thread.ofVirtual().start()`) for millions of concurrent tasks, structured concurrency, platform thread pools with `ThreadPoolExecutor` (tuning core pool size, work queue capacity, and saturation rejection policies), asynchronous composition with `CompletableFuture`, synchronization primitives (`ReentrantLock`, `StampedLock`, `Semaphore`), and lock-free thread safety with `volatile` and `java.util.concurrent.atomic` primitives.

children.name: JVM Internals & Memory Management
children.description: Deep dive into JVM internals and performance tuning: classloader hierarchy (Bootstrap, Platform, App), bytecode execution and JIT compilation (C1 client compiler, C2 optimizing compiler, tiered compilation, GraalVM AOT compilation), JVM memory areas (Young Generation Eden/Survivor, Tenured Old Gen, Metaspace, Thread Stacks), and Garbage Collection algorithms (G1GC tuning, low-latency Generational ZGC, and Shenandoah).

tree.name: Database Fundamentals & ORM
tree.description: Master relational data persistence and Object-Relational Mapping (ORM): ACID transaction isolation, connection pooling, and high-performance JPA/Hibernate integration.

children.name: Relational Database Concepts & SQL
children.description: Master relational database engineering: ACID properties, transaction isolation levels (Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable), diagnosing dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads, indexing strategies (B-Tree indexes, composite indexes, index selectivity), and foreign key constraints.

children.name: JDBC & Basic Data Access
children.description: Master low-level database communication with JDBC: parameterized queries with `PreparedStatement` to eliminate SQL injection, batch operations for bulk inserts, transaction demarcation (`setAutoCommit(false)`, `commit()`, `rollback()`), and connection pool tuning with HikariCP (pool size sizing formula, connection timeout, leak detection threshold).

children.name: JPA & Hibernate ORM
children.description: Master Hibernate and Jakarta Persistence (JPA) internals: persistence context lifecycle, first-level cache vs second-level cache (Redis/Ehcache), dirty checking mechanism, entity states (Transient, Managed, Detached, Removed), diagnosing and resolving the N+1 query problem (`JOIN FETCH`, `@EntityGraph`), and optimistic locking (`@Version`) vs pessimistic locking (`PESSIMISTIC_WRITE`).

tree.name: Spring Boot Core & Web Development
tree.description: Master modern Spring Boot 3 & Spring 6 web application engineering: IoC container, autoconfiguration, RESTful web services, validation, and declarative data access.

children.name: Spring Framework Core Concepts
children.description: Master Spring Core fundamentals: Inversion of Control (IoC) and Dependency Injection (DI) prioritizing constructor injection, bean lifecycles (`@PostConstruct`, `@PreDestroy`, `BeanPostProcessor`), bean scopes (Singleton, Prototype, Request), and component scanning with `@Configuration`, `@Bean`, and `@Component`.

children.name: Introduction to Spring Boot
children.description: Understand Spring Boot 3 internals: condition-based autoconfiguration (`@ConditionalOnClass`, `@ConditionalOnMissingBean`), custom starters, configuration properties binding (`@ConfigurationProperties`), environment profiles (`application.yml`), and migrating to Spring Boot 3 / Java 17+ baseline.

children.name: Building RESTful APIs with Spring Boot
children.description: Engineer production RESTful APIs with Spring Web: `@RestController`, request mapping, path variables, query parameters, request body deserialization, response headers, content negotiation, DTO transformation using MapStruct, and file upload streaming.

children.name: Data Validation & Global Exception Handling
children.description: Implement robust input validation and centralized error handling: Jakarta Bean Validation (`@NotNull`, `@Size`, `@Pattern`, custom validators), nested object validation with `@Valid`, global exception handling using `@RestControllerAdvice` and `@ExceptionHandler`, and standardizing error responses using the RFC 7807 Problem Details specification.

resources.title: Global Exception Handling in Spring Boot

children.name: Spring Data JPA & Transactions
children.description: Master declarative data access with Spring Data JPA: repository interfaces (`JpaRepository`), derived query methods, custom JPQL and native SQL queries (`@Query`), pagination and sorting (`Pageable`, `Slice`), dynamic queries with Specifications, and declarative transaction management (`@Transactional` propagation behaviors like `REQUIRED` and `REQUIRES_NEW`, rollback rules).

tree.name: Enterprise-Grade Spring Development
tree.description: Engineer enterprise-grade Spring Boot microservices: stateless security, event-driven messaging, distributed caching, fault tolerance, and reactive programming.

children.name: Spring Security & Authorization
children.description: Implement enterprise security with Spring Security 6: Security Filter Chain configuration, stateless JWT authentication (access and refresh tokens with RS256 signing), OAuth2 Resource Server integration, Method-level authorization (`@PreAuthorize`), password hashing with BCrypt / Argon2, and CORS and CSRF defense.

children.name: Messaging & Event-Driven Architectures
children.description: Build event-driven distributed systems: messaging with Spring for Apache Kafka and Spring AMQP (RabbitMQ), producer acknowledgments (`acks=all`), consumer group scaling, handling partition rebalances, implementing Dead Letter Queues (DLQ) with retry topics, and the Transactional Outbox Pattern to guarantee at-least-once message publishing.

children.name: Caching Strategies with Spring
children.description: Implement enterprise caching architectures: Spring Cache Abstraction (`@Cacheable`, `@CachePut`, `@CacheEvict`), distributed Redis caching with `RedisTemplate`, mitigating cache stampede and thundering herd problems, configuring cache TTLs with jitter, and cache invalidation strategies.

children.name: Resilience Patterns & Microservices Communication
children.description: Build resilient microservices using Resilience4j: Circuit Breakers (failure rate thresholds, slow call rate thresholds), Rate Limiters, Bulkheads for thread isolation, Retry with exponential backoff, Spring Cloud Gateway for API edge routing, and declarative HTTP clients using Spring 6 `HttpInterfaces` or OpenFeign.

resources.title: Building an API Gateway with Spring Cloud Gateway
Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka for Service Discovery

children.name: Advanced Spring Features
children.description: Master advanced Spring capabilities: Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP with `@Aspect`, `@Around` pointcuts) for cross-cutting telemetry and auditing, reactive asynchronous pipelines with Spring WebFlux and Project Reactor (`Mono`, `Flux`), and chunk-based large-scale batch processing with Spring Batch.

tree.name: Testing & Quality Assurance
tree.description: Enforce automated quality assurance and verification: unit testing pyramids, containerized integration tests, and build tool optimization.

children.name: Unit Testing with JUnit & Mockito
children.description: Master unit testing with JUnit 5 and Mockito: parameterized tests (`@ValueSource`, `@CsvSource`), test lifecycle callbacks, mocking dependencies with `@Mock` and `@InjectMocks`, verifying invocations, argument captors (`ArgumentCaptor`), and writing readable, fluent assertions using AssertJ.

children.name: Integration & Component Testing
children.description: Implement production-grade integration testing in Spring: `@SpringBootTest`, slice testing (`@WebMvcTest`, `@DataJpaTest`), and Testcontainers to spin up isolated, ephemeral PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kafka containers in Docker for 100% deterministic test execution.

children.name: Build Tools & Dependency Management
children.description: Master enterprise build automation with Maven and Gradle: multi-module project architectures, managing dependency versions with BOMs, resolving transitive dependency version conflicts, build caching, and static code quality plugins (Spotless, JaCoCo coverage gates).

tree.name: Deployment & Operations
tree.description: Deploy, monitor, and scale production Java applications: containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, distributed observability, and cloud native deployment.

children.name: Version Control & CI/CD
children.description: Implement trunk-based Git workflows and continuous delivery pipelines: GitHub Actions / GitLab CI for compiling, running multi-container tests, generating vulnerability reports with OWASP Dependency-Check / Snyk, and automated artifact publishing to container registries.

children.name: Containerization & Orchestration
children.description: Containerize and orchestrate Spring Boot applications: multi-stage Docker builds utilizing layered JARs (`layertools`) or Cloud Native Buildpacks (Paketo), optimizing image sizes with Distroless/Alpine base images, and authoring Kubernetes manifests (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, PDBs, HPA).

children.name: Monitoring, Logging & Tracing
children.description: Implement enterprise observability for Spring Boot: Spring Boot Actuator health endpoints (`/health/liveness`, `/health/readiness`), structured JSON logging with Logback/Logstash, application metrics collection with Micrometer and Prometheus, and distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Micrometer Tracing, and Jaeger/Tempo.

resources.title: Monitoring Spring Boot with Prometheus and Grafana

children.name: Cloud Deployment Basics
children.description: Deploy and operate Spring Boot on cloud platforms: AWS ECS/EKS or Google Cloud Run, configuring managed databases (AWS RDS PostgreSQL), IAM role-based identity delegation, and integrating cloud secrets managers.

resources.title: Deploy Spring Boot to AWS EC2

tree.name: Software Design & Best Practices
tree.description: Architect clean, maintainable software systems: SOLID principles, design patterns, Domain-Driven Design, and API standards.

children.name: Object-Oriented Design & Patterns
children.description: Master software architectural patterns in Java: SOLID design principles, Gang of Four patterns (Factory, Builder, Strategy, Observer, Decorator), and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) tactical patterns (Entities, Value Objects, Aggregates, Repositories, Domain Events).

children.name: Clean Code & Refactoring
children.description: Write clean, maintainable enterprise Java: identifying and refactoring code smells, eliminating cognitive complexity, enforcing architectural boundaries with ArchUnit, and conducting high-signal peer code reviews.

children.name: API Design Principles & Documentation
children.description: Design enterprise RESTful APIs: consistent resource URI conventions, HTTP status code semantics, pagination and filtering standards, backward-compatible API versioning, and auto-generating interactive OpenAPI 3.0 documentation using Springdoc-OpenAPI.

tree.name: Capstone Project: Full-Stack Banking Application
tree.description: Capstone: Architect, implement, test, and deploy an enterprise-grade fintech banking core service in Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.

children.name: Project Planning & Architecture
children.description: Project Architecture: Define system requirements and domain models for a multi-tenant core banking engine: double-entry bookkeeping ledger, ACID transactional guarantees, event-driven architecture, and zero-trust security specifications.

children.name: Implementation & Testing
children.description: Project Implementation: Develop core banking capabilities in Java 21 & Spring Boot 3: double-entry ledger transactions with optimistic locking, Spring Security stateless JWT authentication, event streaming with Kafka, HikariCP connection pool tuning, and an automated integration test suite using Testcontainers with 85%+ code coverage.

children.name: Deployment & Documentation
children.description: Project Deployment: Package into multi-stage container images, deploy with Docker Compose / Kubernetes, configure Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for Actuator metrics and latency percentiles, and publish interactive OpenAPI Swagger documentation.
